workbench.noCatalog: No catalog yet. It appears once this datasource's proxy connects and pushes its schema.

history.empty: No queries yet — run one to start your history.

logs.countThisSession: {count, plural, one {# statement this session} other {# statements this session}}
logs.emptyTitle: No statements run this session — query and table-preview executions appear here.
logs.rowsLine: {count, plural, one {# row retrieved} other {# rows retrieved}} (execution: {ms} ms)
logs.maskedRowsLine: {count, plural, one {# row retrieved, masked} other {# rows retrieved, masked}} (execution: {ms} ms)

requestAccess.title: Request access
requestAccess.description: Request a time-boxed role grant. An approver grants it on the Workflows page; once granted, re-running the query just works.
requestAccess.descriptionWithDatasource: Request a time-boxed role grant on {name}. An approver grants it on the Workflows page; once granted, re-running the query just works.
requestAccess.successDescription: An approver can grant it on the Workflows page, then re-run the query.

results.cappedAt: The result cap stopped this at {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} — the set is incomplete.
results.canceledDescription: The running query was canceled. No result was saved.
results.noResultsDescription: Write SQL and press Run (or ⌘/Ctrl + Enter).
results.denyFallback: Blocked by policy. No rows were returned.
results.denyHelp: Request approval = ask an approver to allow this exact query; Request access = ask for a role.
results.rowsAffectedLine: {count, plural, one {# row affected.} other {# rows affected.}}

schema.noMatch: No schemas, tables, or columns match.

table.previewUnavailable: Data preview is unavailable for this catalog.
table.loadErrorFallback: The live table detail request failed.
table.loadErrorTitle: Unable to load live table detail
table.noColumns: No columns reported by the target.
table.noIndexes: No indexes reported by the target.
table.noForeignKeys: This table has no outbound foreign keys.
table.noReferencedBy: No other tables reference this table.

rateReset.title: Request a rate reset
rateReset.description: Your relayed-volume rate for this window is spent. An approver can reset it on the Workflows page; the reset clears every window at once and leaves the per-statement cap alone.
rateReset.reasonPlaceholder: Why the extra volume is needed now.
rateReset.successDescription: An approver can reset it on the Workflows page; then re-run the query.
rateReset.denyHelp: Your relayed-volume rate for this window is spent. Ask an approver to reset it, or wait for the window to roll off.

session.closeDescription: Its database connection closes. The database rolls back any open transaction and drops session variables and temporary tables. A running query is canceled. The next run opens a new session.
session.closed: Session ended. Any open transaction was rolled back.

runRules.selectOne: This editor holds several statements. Select the one statement to run, then press Run.
runRules.useRunAll: The selection holds several statements. Run runs one; use Run All to run a script.
runRules.selectAll: Run All runs the whole script. Select all of it (⌘/Ctrl + A), then press Run All.

runAll.shortcut: Run the whole script as one unit (Shift + ⌘/Ctrl + Enter)
runAll.timeoutOption: {seconds, select, 30 {30 s} 60 {1 min} 300 {5 min} 600 {10 min} other {{seconds} s}}
runAll.tabTitle: Run All · {count, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}
runAll.autocommitDescription: This script does not start with START TRANSACTION or BEGIN, so each statement commits as it runs. If a later statement fails, the earlier ones stay committed.

outcome.running: Running on a dedicated connection. If a statement fails, is denied, is canceled, or runs out of time, the connection closes and the database rolls back any open transaction.
outcome.committed: Every statement ran. The connection is closed.
outcome.endedOpen: Every statement ran, but the script left its transaction open. The connection closed, so the database rolled it back.
outcome.stopped: The script stopped. The connection closed, so the database rolled back any open transaction. Statements committed before that stay committed.
